title: Diagnostics, failure modes and fail-closed behavior
policy: This bootstrap inventories and maps existing evidence. It does not close G11, promote a capability, or replace route-specific validation.

common_failure_envelope.decision: The envelope is an evidence schema, not a replacement exception hierarchy and not a qualification result.

field_rules.FAILURE_CLASS: stable taxonomy value; never inferred only from free-form log text
field_rules.ROUTE: declared analysis route or infrastructure boundary
field_rules.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: explicit reject, terminate, retry-after-rollback, or diagnostic-only outcome
field_rules.ERROR_TYPE_OR_CODE: route-native exception/type or stable diagnostic code; a common Python exception is not required
field_rules.STATE_PRESERVED: true, false, or NOT_APPLICABLE; false is never eligible for PASS
field_rules.DETERMINISTIC: boolean; repeated controlled input must be checked when the case is repeatable
field_rules.NO_NAN_INF: boolean; true is required for any accepted failure record
field_rules.NO_SILENT_PASS: boolean; true is mandatory for every G11 failure record
field_rules.EVIDENCE_ID: stable case or artifact identifier with provenance

common_failure_envelope.implementation_status: schema approved for future adapters; current route evidence remains route-specific

UNCONTROLLED.note: No uncontrolled failure was demonstrated by the reviewed evidence; raw low-level exceptions and cross-route continuation still require explicit future audit.

MISSING: complete cross-route failure corpus beyond the focused envelope
complete contact failure corpus under one G11 oracle
cross-route proof that no failed solve can be reported as PASS across every public route

requirements.title: Invalid inputs fail closed
requirements.expected_behavior: Reject before a valid result is emitted, with an explicit stable public error class and actionable message.
requirements.oracle: expected_exception_class_and_message; repeat execution produces the same diagnostic

requirements.title: Singular and ill-conditioned systems are explicit
requirements.expected_behavior: Terminate with a classified numerical or input failure; never return NaN, Inf, or a false converged mode/result.
requirements.oracle: error_class_or_failure_reason plus finite-output and termination invariants

requirements.title: Unsupported capability combinations are rejected
requirements.expected_behavior: Reject explicitly at schema, mesh, route or policy boundary; no silent fallback to another formulation or route.
requirements.oracle: expected public rejection class/message and route remains unchanged

requirements.title: Numerical non-convergence and failure reasons are preserved
requirements.expected_behavior: Return or raise a non-converged outcome with a stable reason, message, diagnostics and no successful result claim.
requirements.oracle: NonlinearFailureReason membership; diagnostics payload; finite-state and failed-status invariants

requirements.title: Diagnostics are deterministic and exploitable
requirements.expected_behavior: Repeated identical inputs produce the same class, reason and essential diagnostic fields; diagnostics identify stage and failure without requiring log text parsing alone.
requirements.oracle: two-run diagnostic equality for class/reason/essential fields and explicit JSON serialization

requirements.title: Rollback and state integrity survive rejected trials
requirements.expected_behavior: Rejected trial state is discarded, committed state is unchanged, retry starts from the committed state, and rollback is recorded.
requirements.oracle: committed-state equality before/after rejection; rollback_verified=true; deterministic retry outcome

requirements.title: Failure evidence has provenance and maturity boundaries
requirements.expected_behavior: Record source SHA, clean state, environment, case ID, evidence path/digest, capability/requirement mapping and whether evidence is diagnostic-only.
requirements.oracle: registry consistency, manifest digest and no silent gate closure

requirements.title: No silent fail-open or false PASS
requirements.expected_behavior: Failure remains failure/expected failure/diagnostic-only; no NaN/Inf continuation; no unsupported fallback; no threshold weakening to hide an anomaly.
requirements.oracle: status/reason consistency, finite-output invariant, explicit expected-failure classification and unchanged policy source

runner.execution_model: inject route-native adapters; runner captures and normalizes evidence without changing solver route implementations
